results.title: Trio
results.overview: All good things come in threes. Or do they?

results.title: Tiger's Smile
results.overview: Sixteen-year-old Leni grows up in poverty, shaped by her mother Jana’s alcoholism and constant financial worries. When mother and daughter go to return their collected bottles at the local supermarket, Leni runs into her classmate Sophia. Sophia belongs to a clique of wealthy girls who, unlike Leni, seem to drift through life without a care.

results.title: Curtains
results.overview: In CURTAINS, Sandra Hüller tells the story of a woman who breaks out of a long-term violent relationship and of a political and social system that prefers to look the other way. The film shows the power structures behind the facades and how the state inadequately protects women.

results.title: Chirac sous les Tropiques, petits arrangements avec la République
results.original_title: Chirac sous les Tropiques, petits arrangements avec la République

results.title: They call me Lars
results.overview: The story of the film *They Call Me Lars* pays homage to the “hard-boiled detective genre,” with present-day Prague standing in for 1930s Los Angeles. But private eye Lars doesn’t wear a suit like the legendary detective Phil Marlowe of old. He’s a tough guy in a leather jacket, with a shaved head and a scruffy beard. After being kicked out of the police force for complete insubordination, he scrapes by however he can. He solves various problems for his clients or, conversely, causes trouble for others. It depends on the assignment. The only thing left to him from his time in the service is his former partner and friend Gold.  The only thing he has left from his time in government service is his former partner and friend Gold, and it is Gold who offers him a lucrative deal.

results.title: Home
results.overview: Where does the Ukrainian road home begin and where does it end? The poetic journey follows a Ukrainian actress, Yelyzaveta, who emigrated to Lithuania, traveling back to her homeland country ravaged by war. Will we reach the final destination? How to reach home? Relatives? How to get back to the past which no longer exists? Can we wake up from the dream?

results.title: Airy in Busan
results.original_title: อีแหล่ แอรี่ เกาหลี โอปป้า
results.overview: A female parade-band singer and the backbone of her family faces a life in ruins when she is kicked out of the band, dumped by her boyfriend, and overwhelmed by debt. She decides to travel to South Korea with her best friend to search for a new way to survive.

results.title: Black Water
results.overview: 19-year-old Noah, who's living with his mom and sister in an old, dilapidated house on the outskirts of Boston, is sitting in therapy, as he's suffering from dark and potentially dangerous visions at night. During one of his sessions, he's asked to revisit some of these visions, forcing him back to a time of horror and distress.

results.title: Road To L'Etape Du Tour
results.overview: Facing a turning point in her life, a woman with a congenital heart defect embarks on a journey to train for a stage of the Tour de France.

results.title: As Long As It Snows
results.overview: As a child, Margo witnesses her best friend vanish into a snowstorm, marking her for life. Twenty years later, now a teacher, one of her students vanishes under similar circumstances. During the search, she meets a man who bears an unsettling resemblance to her childhood friend.

results.title: Di Renjie: Six Dragon Phases
results.overview: When Di Renjie first took office as the Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, he was tasked with investigating the whereabouts of the six Xuanlong artifacts that Chancellor Han had left behind several years earlier. Di Renjie traveled between Taoist temples, secret cult strongholds, and ancient ruins in search of the artifacts, eventually discovering that using all six together would create an illusion that could cause people to die suddenly. Within the illusion of the ruins, Lord Li, consumed by his desire for immortality, succumbed to the poison and died. Di Renjie then destroyed all the artifacts, safeguarding the peace of the Tang Dynasty.

results.title: Maybe We Should
results.overview: Determined to bring hope to their rural Pennsylvania community, a couple embark on an ambitious mission to establish a revolutionary therapy center for children with special needs.

results.title: Suffs
results.overview: Created by Tony Award winner Shaina Taub, this musical recorded from Broadway tells the story of the American suffragist movement and the remarkable friendships, heartbreak, and action that brought women together—or, in some cases, tore them apart. The ensemble cast features Taub as Alice Paul, Tony winner Nikki M. James as Ida B. Wells, Tony nominee Jenn Colella as Carrie Chapman Catt, and Grace McLean as President Woodrow Wilson.

results.title: Last Rain On My Parade
results.overview: A hair washer confronts her loneliness on the city's most turbulent night.

results.title: Lipán
results.overview: A documentary following Tomás Lipán, a musician from Jujuy who travels the world carrying the living memory of his homeland. Moving between urban stages and ancestral landscapes, he emerges as a troubadour inhabiting two worlds: that of travel and that of his roots. The film blends musical performance with sensory experience, where music, territory, and ritual merge into a single form.

results.title: Rotten
results.overview: Stella spends her 18th birthday alone in her room.

results.title: My Life for My Word
results.overview: The feature-length documentary "Za slovo ručím životem" captures the sometimes uncompromising stances of the internationally acclaimed Czech writer Radka Denemarková, as well as the accessibility of the themes in her work to an international audience. Denemarková regards her literary talent as a gift and sees the fight for the human dignity of those who would otherwise never be heard as her moral duty. Her novels, which reflect both our present and recent past – such as Hodiny z olova and Peníze od Hitlera  – have been translated into twenty-five languages. Thanks to her natural charm, openness and unique sense of humour during book talks and award ceremonies, the author has gained admirers all over the world.

results.title: Heather McMahan: By a Thread
results.overview: Everyone’s stressed. We’re all hanging on BY A THREAD. But don’t worry, we can all laugh about it together. BY A THREAD. October 16. Hulu.

results.title: You're All Doomed
results.overview: Burned alive in an accident and locked away, the urban legend of Crispy refuses to die. Escaping the asylum, the scarred killer returns to Camp Hollow, where a group of unsuspecting campers find their weekend of fun twisted into a nightmare of fire, blood, and vengeance as his rage consumes the woods once more.
